mapper.sql: select id, conversation_id, user_id, file_name, original_file_name, file_url, file_path, mime_type, file_size, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, retry_count, processing_started_at, processing_finished_at, expire_time, create_time, update_time from rag_session_document
mapper.insert: insert into rag_session_document ( id, conversation_id, user_id, file_name, original_file_name, file_url, file_path, mime_type, file_size, parse_status, chunk_count, token_count, error_message, retry_count, processing_started_at, processing_finished_at, expire_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{parseStatus}, #{chunkCount}, #{tokenCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryCount}, #{processingStartedAt}, #{processingFinishedAt}, #{expireTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update rag_session_document set parse_status = 'PARSING', error_message = null, processing_started_at = sysdate(), processing_finished_at = null, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and parse_status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

update rag_session_document set parse_status = 'PENDING', error_message = null, retry_count = coalesce(retry_count, 0) + 1, processing_started_at = null, processing_finished_at = null, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and parse_status in ('READY', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')

update rag_session_document set parse_status = 'PENDING', error_message = '应用上次退出时任务中断，已自动重新排队', retry_count = coalesce(retry_count, 0) + 1, processing_started_at = null, processing_finished_at = null, update_time = sysdate() where parse_status in ('PARSING', 'CHUNKING', 'EMBEDDING')
